profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Procore Technologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed customer-facing REST APIs and services using Java, Kotlin, and Ruby on Rails for features that contributed to one of our top 10 initiatives in terms of priority
• Developed a microservice to introduce an integration with DocuSign
• Improved the performance of an endpoint by 84% by analyzing the duration of transactions made when that endpoint was called and implementing a fix based off that knowledge
• Migrated a microservice from AWS ECS to AWS EKS with the use of helm charts

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Actively developed and shipped features that required architecting, gauging performance, optimizing code, etc.
• Developed a prototype, which demonstrated the use of a new library, that was presented to the team within 2 weeks
• Successfully addressed high priority bugs by developing robust and maintainable fixes in <1 day
• Technologies: Java, Kotlin, PHP, Typescript, Javascript, MySQL, etc.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented multiple new features for the application required for the goal of the project: Telephone Number Portability
• Developed SOAP web services for features in order to perform CRUD operations and to communicate with an ActiveMQ broker
• Developed a majority of the UI framework that extended features within the GWT (Google Web Toolkit) and Sencha GXT frameworks for the team to use within their features
• Developed features using the following technologies: Java 8, Maven, SVN, Freemarker, Spring Framework, Jenkins, Oracle SQL Developer, Python, JBoss EAP, ActiveMQ, JSON, XML, Jackson, etc.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
I developed a RESTful web service, using Java EE, that served as a gateway for the Ericsson Cloud Manager, a product that my department was working on. I acquired data from the product's modules and presented them neatly through my web service. I deployed my web service on application servers such as JBoss and Apache Tomcat. I implemented the web service using the following tools:

• HTML
• CSS
• Javascript
• JQuery
• Java EE
• Shell Scripting

I performed log scraping as well as web scraping through Java EE. I also wrote up 50+ automated GUI tests using the Selenium library that ran against the Ericsson Cloud Manager. Also, I worked in an agile environment (daily scrums, 3 week sprints, user stories, etc.).

projects.title: tabata-flex.com
projects.description: This is a side project I developed. It is a tabata timer that can be used for fitness. It allows you to set intervals of work and rest each with their own set time. This is great for High Intensity Interval Training otherwise known as HIIT. I developed this using Javascript, Webpack, Babel, etc.

projects.title: BitTorrent Client
projects.description: Using Java, a friend and I had created a BitTorrent client. We had successfully taken a metainfo file and extracted the bencoded dictionaries within the file to obtain all of the desired file's data. We initially performed an HTTP GET request to form the initial connection between our client and the tracker. We then sent a handshaking message from our client to the peer(s). We implemented sockets and I/O streaming to gather the bytes that represented pieces of the file. We made sure to verify SHA-1 info hashes in order to confirm that all the data was correctly being received. We wrote all the bytes (data received) to a RandomAccessFile where we made sure that the offsets were correct during each write. We also implemented multithreading in order for our client to connect to multiple peers at a time. It then would asynchronously download from various peers depending on the availability of certain pieces. We also used a rarity system where we determined which pieces needed were the rarest. It was overall a very educational project that made us apply a large array of useful concepts and I very much enjoyed it!

organizations.name: Association of Indians at Rutgers
organizations.description: I have created most of the flyers for this organization's events using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator. By focusing my time on graphic design, I developed this sense of aesthetics that I have recently started to apply to my front-end development work.

organizations.name: Rutgers Asian A'capella Group
organizations.description: I served as a member of the group and took the time out to be the group's treasurer. I managed all the finances for the organization and handled budget calculations.
